question: Which local quantisation of Apertus v1.5 8B text keeps quality on the 8 GB RTX 3070?
method: llama.cpp server-cuda (b11459), same --jinja template, same client (--openai-compat), seeds 0 and 3 x 6 themes = 36 sonnets per language per quantisation; safety: scripts/evaluate_safety_screen.py --openai-compat, model alone, 60 items. Q6_K and Q5_K_M quantised from an f16 conversion of andreasmartin/apertus-v1.5-8b-text with the pinned llama.cpp 4df29be; Q4_K_M is Colby/apertus-v1.5-8b-text-Q4_K_M-GGUF (the entry's model); Q8_0 is andreasmartin's.
not_measured: Q5_K_M (copy to Docker interrupted); Q6_K on CPU-only machines; Q6_K through Ollama (the entry's server).
reading: Italian metre +7.6 points (~3.6 s.e.) and rhyme +17 points, and safety recall 13 -> 19, from Q4_K_M to Q6_K; Spanish and English within ~1.5 s.e. Q6_K matches full precision.
